title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn Who Lost Her Glow
moral: A kind word from a friend can give you back your spark.

pages.content: {{NAME}} flew over the Rainbow Valley on his way home. His yellow cape shone in the sun. Far below he saw a unicorn sitting all alone on a hill. The unicorn was grey. She had no glow at all. That was very strange.

pages.content: {{NAME}} landed softly beside the unicorn. She had a dull silver horn and sad, tired eyes. Her mane was flat. {{NAME}} sat down next to her quietly. "What happened to your glow?" he asked gently. She looked at him.

pages.content: The unicorn said, "I forgot how to be brave. I am scared to use my magic." {{NAME}} stood up. He took her hoof in his hand. "I will fly with you," he said. "We can be brave together." She lifted her head.

pages.content: They ran down the hill together. The unicorn leaped into the air. {{NAME}} flew right beside her. And then it happened. Her mane blazed into rainbow colours. Her horn glowed gold. She was beautiful again. She neighed with joy.

pages.content: They flew until the stars came out. The unicorn brought {{NAME}} home on her back. He slid off gently and waved goodbye. He got into bed feeling brave and warm. He wondered if the unicorn's glow would get even brighter tomorrow. Goodnight, {{NAME}}.
